exact_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: original handpainted diffuse CLOTHING full UV bitmap. Faithfully render SAME original sourceart at higherresolution with very subtle fine paint refinement, SAME material/blur/nativepaintscale/palette/normalizedUV. This remains a flat UV TEXTURE bitmap, no assembled object/photo.

Image1 is the exact ENTIRE original native 256x128 storedRGB madeopaque at ORIGINAL resolution, no NN enlargement/blockguide. NativeOrdinary straightRGB/noPremul, originalcomplete A255 separately restored downstream with standardwhole numericalbrightnessscalar. Source A255 black/dimRGB is authoredpaint/UV, not empty newholes. Preserve every original sourcepixel field.

Keep ONE original darkgray softlypainted leftfield, ONE khakigreen middlefield with its existing broad dim softwash, ONE smooth warmbrown upperrightplane and exact lowerdarkgray fields/curvepaint. Native256x128 boundaries: middle x95..185 ending y99, warmbrown right x186..255 ending y82. TWO existing little warmbrown ovalpaint marks remain in x29..69,y107..126, exactly TWO, same mutedcontrast/size/outline. Preserve every faint leftgray foldwash and middlekhaki broad tonalwash without adding wrinkles/weave/grain/pockets/stitches or raisedstructure. Original lowergray curvepaint and narrowrightlower grayfields remain indistinct mattepaint, NOT newlyinterpreted hardware. Keep warmbrown plane smooth with same original broad dim highlights, no pores/anatomy. Preserve authoredblack gaps and all gray/khaki/warmbrown relative localtones.

Exact original RGBA extrema [[0, 186], [0, 134], [0, 107], [255, 255]]; strongest originalnativeRGBA [181, 134, 82, 255] at [244, 15]. Keep strongest and weakest originallocalpaint at SAME local strength/extent; do not intensify highlights/weakwashed marks or introduce newcontrasting contours. Coordinates refer to nativeoriginal pixels normalized to completecanvas, not newgeometry.

Preserve soft sourceblur and subdued matte sourcepalette, broad weakwash fields and flatbackgrounds. Finepaint ONLYwithin existing material and scale; no photo leathergrain/wovenfibers/newwrinkles/creases/regulargrid/mosaic/coarsecells/rust/etchedscratches/whitebevels/raised rims/shine/hardware/bolts/buttons/pockets/straps/letters/symbols/markinterpretation. No newparts, glints or changed existingcounts.

Output ONLY the SAME ENTIRE sourceUVcanvas with original 256:128 aspect, OPAQUE storedRGB. No padding/whitespace/border/frame/zoom/crop/recenter/BBox/fit/registration/repack/islandmoves/assembledobject/photo. Complete originalA/sourceblackUV/count/phase/material/nativepaintscale retained.
